skills.name: commentary-brainstorm-review
skills.summary: Apply accepted consensus changes from Commentary Brainstorming Reviews.
skills.description: Use Commentary Brainstorming Reviews from an agent to monitor multi-user consensus, apply accepted changes to reviewed pages, and mark brainstorming threads addressed. Trigger this skill when a user mentions Commentary brainstorming, consensus review, voting on draft changes, accepted consensus, brainstorm status, brainstorm next, applying agreed changes, or when an agent must choose between a remote MCP-only Commentary review and a local file-backed Commentary review using the CLI.

interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-brainstorm-review to apply accepted consensus changes from a Commentary Brainstorming Review.

skills.name: commentary-draft-review
skills.summary: Use the Commentary CLI for live collaborative review of local text artifacts.
skills.description: Use Commentary draft reviews from an agent via the Commentary CLI for live collaborative review of Markdown, MDX, HTML, and plain text artifacts. Trigger this skill when a user asks to create, draft, edit, revise, share, or review a blog post, spec, proposal, report, documentation page, or other text artifact with Commentary; when they mention Commentary draft reviews, live comments, watch-comment, review it with commentary, or using an agent and human reviewer together; and when the agent needs to set up authentication, create/sync/watch/share a review, read or wait for comments, reply to comments, resolve threads, manage comments by other reviewers, or decide whether to use the CLI or an already-installed Commentary MCP server.

interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-draft-review to draft a Markdown artifact and review it with Commentary.

skills.name: commentary-live-preview-review
skills.summary: Set up Commentary Live Preview Reviews and address live web app comments.
skills.description: Set up and use Commentary Live Preview Reviews for web apps through the Commentary review SDK and MCP. Trigger this skill when a user wants to add @commentary-dev/review-sdk or the Commentary CDN SDK to a React, Next.js, Vite, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Astro, static HTML, or other browser app; launch a localhost or deployed live preview review; listen for Web App Review comments through the Commentary MCP server; address selected-element comments; resolve review threads; handle localhost immediate feedback; or apply deployed-review rules based on review owner, current user, comment author, and agent alias tags.

interface.short_description: SDK setup and live app comments
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-live-preview-review to add the Commentary SDK and address Live Preview Review comments.

skills.name: commentary-pr-review
skills.summary: Operate rendered GitHub and Azure DevOps PR reviews through Commentary MCP.
skills.description: Operate an existing GitHub or Azure DevOps pull-request or repository-document review through Commentary MCP. Use when an agent must inspect rendered files, list or address review threads, preserve provider permissions, check revision-specific approval gates, or continue PR work without duplicating the workflow through the Commentary CLI.

interface.short_description: Operate rendered PR reviews through Commentary
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-pr-review to inspect and address the open review feedback on this PR.

skills.name: review-agentic-plans
skills.summary: Review agent-generated plans for intent, evidence, risk, and decision completeness.
skills.description: Review an implementation plan, technical design, specification, or agent-generated proposal for intent, evidence, tradeoffs, risk, and decision completeness. Use before execution when a plan needs substantive critique; do not activate merely to proofread prose or operate Commentary tools.

interface.short_description: Find plan risks before an agent executes
interface.default_prompt: Use $review-agentic-plans to critique this plan for evidence, risk, and missing decisions.

skills.name: commentary-form-creation
skills.summary: Design and create Commentary Form Contract v1 forms.
skills.description: Create, validate, revise, and publish Commentary Form Contract v1 YAML or JSON through source-backed files, Draft Review, response links, and Commentary MCP. Use for contract mechanics and form operations after the questions and experience are designed; use design-effective-forms for question quality, flow, accessibility, appearance, and adaptive-form judgment.

interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-form-creation to implement and validate this Commentary Form contract.

skills.name: commentary-form-design
skills.summary: Build rich Markdown, MDX, HTML, and custom renderer form experiences.
skills.description: Route existing Commentary Form design requests to the focused rendering or form-practice workflow. Use this compatibility skill when a request mentions the former Commentary Form Design skill: choose commentary-form-rendering for Markdown, HTML, SDK, or custom-renderer mechanics, and design-effective-forms for questions, flow, accessibility, visual quality, or adaptive personalization.

interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-form-design to build a polished Markdown or HTML Commentary form page.

skills.name: commentary-form-rendering
skills.summary: Implement Commentary Form renderers, bindings, and SDK bridges.
skills.description: Implement a Commentary Form as native rendering, a Markdown or MDX embed, declarative static HTML, or a customer-owned Live Preview custom renderer. Use for data-commentary bindings, Forms SDK bridge integration, sandbox and origin constraints, responsive control implementation, and renderer review handoff; use design-effective-forms for question and experience decisions.

interface.short_description: Implement secure rich Commentary Form renderers
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-form-rendering to implement this form in the appropriate Commentary rendering surface.

skills.name: design-effective-forms
skills.summary: Design clear, accessible, unbiased, and adaptive forms.
skills.description: Design or critique a form, questionnaire, intake, assessment, checklist, or adaptive follow-up flow for clear questions, unbiased responses, accessibility, visual quality, and respondent trust. Use before implementation even when Commentary is not connected; use commentary-form-creation or commentary-form-rendering afterward for product mechanics.

interface.default_prompt: Use $design-effective-forms to improve this form's questions, flow, accessibility, and respondent trust.

skills.name: commentary-form-results
skills.summary: Fetch, poll, normalize, and export Commentary Forms results.
skills.description: Fetch, poll, process, normalize, export, and sync Commentary Forms results. Use when a user asks to list form submissions, read embedded answers, process response-link results, export form results as JSON YAML CSV JSONL or another structured dataset, poll for new submissions, import or inspect canonical git-hosted result files, write final submissions back to GitHub through Commentary, or transform Commentary Forms result payloads for downstream analysis.

interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-form-results to fetch and normalize Commentary Forms submissions.

skills.name: commentary-form-result-visualizations
skills.summary: Create accessible visualizations from Commentary Forms results.
skills.description: Create accessible visualizations and dashboards for Commentary Forms results. Use when a user wants charts, tables, summaries, HTML reports, JavaScript dashboards, trend views, distributions, comparisons, response completion views, risk matrices, qualitative coding summaries, or recommendations for visualizing normalized Commentary Forms submissions from MCP, API exports, CSV, JSON, JSONL, or canonical git result files.

interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-form-result-visualizations to create an accessible dashboard from Forms results.

skills.name: commentary-research-workflow
skills.summary: Operate source-backed Commentary Research Studies through MCP and Draft Review.
skills.description: Operate source-backed Commentary Research Studies through MCP and Draft Review. Use for capability discovery, typed workflow proposals, study and session inspection, participant-event observation, step-scoped comments, evidence and result reads, findings proposals, and review handoff while preserving human control over launch, consent, access, destinations, acceptance, and publication.

interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-research-workflow to inspect this study and propose the next authorized research action.

skills.name: design-product-research
skills.summary: Design ethical, decision-focused product research using established UX methods.
skills.description: Design or critique product research using established UX methods, including interviews, usability testing, concept studies, contextual work, surveys, diary-style studies, benchmarking, and mixed methods. Use for research questions, method choice, participants, tasks, consent, evidence, synthesis, and findings even when Commentary is not connected.

interface.default_prompt: Use $design-product-research to turn these assumptions into a credible product research study.
